body:
Build 0086. S08E04. Amsterdam final cluster.

A-353 Prinsengracht 1785 31ft FOUND — Patriot movement, city deciding.
A-354 Keizersgracht 1787 44ft crisis-amplification — fear runs regardless of outcome.
A-355 Herengracht 1789 FAREWELL — new type: sustained presence in act of voluntary departure; mechanism records love of place in act of leaving.

Tyler: More than I want to count.

Amsterdam complete: 31 sites, ~650ft. FAREWELL taxonomy added to canon. Retroactive FAREWELL audit proposed.

Camera Op captured the canal light on the last day. The light was never the problem.

Lore: TYLER-070 Footnote 74, Camera Op Entry 63, Jiangshi Memo #050.
title: S08E04 The Ending — FAREWELL type; Amsterdam complete; 1789 discontinuity; A-353-A-355
